prompt:
A plain character reference sheet of ONE person: three photographs of the same
16 years old boy side by side against the
same plain backdrop.

Panel 1: head and shoulders, straight to camera, neutral expression, looking into the lens.
Panel 2: the same head and shoulders turned three-quarters to the left.
Panel 3: the same person full body, standing straight and relaxed, arms at their sides,
feet slightly apart, facing camera.

The person:
- 16 years old, a high-school player — a teenager, not a grown professional.
- 5'10" and visibly strong for his age: wide, well-developed shoulders and a thick neck, heavy powerful thighs and calves built by skating, narrow waist. Solid and athletic — NOT slight, NOT skinny, NOT lanky. Still a teenager's frame though, not a fully filled-out adult one.
- fair skin that flushes red across the cheeks and nose with exertion.
- Hair: dark brown, damp and matted flat at the temples from the helmet, curling at the neck.
- Face: a long face with a slightly crooked nose, a faint scar through the right eyebrow, grey-blue eyes set fairly deep, no facial hair beyond a little uneven fuzz on the jaw.

Wearing a plain unbranded grey training t-shirt and shorts in all three panels. No sports
equipment, no helmet, no hat, no glasses — nothing may cover the face or the hairline.

This must look like an actual photograph of an actual teenager, taken by a person with
a camera. Skin has visible pore texture, faint blemishes, uneven tone, a flush of blood
where they have been working. Hair is made of separate strands with flyaways that catch
the rim light, not a moulded mass. Eyebrows are uneven. The face is asymmetric, the way
every real face is. Fabric creases, bunches at the joints and darkens where it is damp.
Equipment is used: scuffed, scratched, tape worn at the edges.

Lighting, identical in every shot: a large soft key from camera-left and slightly above,
a hard rim light from behind camera-right that separates the shoulders, helmet and hair
from the backdrop, and a weak fill from below-right. Neutral white balance. No coloured
gels, no arena lighting, no atmosphere, no haze, no lens flare.

Hard requirements:
- Flat, evenly lit seamless mid-grey backdrop behind all three panels — plain, no gradient, no vignette, no floor line, no shadow cast onto it, no set, no props.
- The three panels are edge to edge, touching, with no white gutter, no border, no frame,
  no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark.
- The build in panel 3 must match the description above exactly. Do not default to a
  thin, slight or lanky teenager — that is this stage's most common failure.
- It is unmistakably the SAME person in all three panels — same face, same hair, same build.
- Sharp focus on the face in every panel. No motion blur, no depth-of-field blur on the face.
- No airbrushed, retouched or beauty-filtered skin. No skin smoothing of any kind.
- No waxy or plastic sheen on the face, no glowing translucent skin, no mannequin look.
- No 3D render, no CGI, no video-game character, no digital sculpt, no illustration.
- No perfectly symmetric face, no flawless white teeth, no poreless skin.
- No brand-new spotless uniform and no factory-fresh equipment.
- Not an adult professional athlete — this is a high-school age player.
